quests.hint: This verb means to discuss something to reach an agreement, especially on price or terms.
quests.explanation: 'Negotiate a deal,' 'negotiate a salary,' and 'negotiate terms' are key professional collocations. 'Negotiation' is the noun. 'Open to negotiation' means willing to discuss.
quests.textToSpeak: They had to ___ the price carefully before they could agree on a final deal.
quests.correctAnswer: They had to negotiate the price carefully before they could agree on a final deal.

quests.hint: This noun refers to a middle position reached when both sides give up something.
quests.explanation: 'Reach a compromise,' 'make a compromise,' and 'fair compromise' are key. 'Compromise' can also be a verb: 'We compromised on the deadline.' 'Without compromise' means absolutely.
quests.textToSpeak: Both sides had to ___ in order to reach an agreement everyone was satisfied with.
quests.correctAnswer: Both sides had to compromise in order to reach an agreement everyone was satisfied with.

quests.hint: This is a formal written plan proposing a course of action for approval.
quests.explanation: 'Submit a proposal,' 'put forward a proposal,' and 'business proposal' are natural. 'Proposal' can also mean an offer of marriage. 'Proposal document' is the formal written version.
quests.textToSpeak: She wrote a detailed ___ outlining the new strategy and submitted it to the board.
quests.correctAnswer: She wrote a detailed proposal outlining the new strategy and submitted it to the board.

quests.hint: This adjective describes work done from home or away from the central office.
quests.explanation: 'Remote working,' 'work remotely,' 'remote team,' and 'remote access' are key. 'Working from home' and 'working remotely' are now common flexible work arrangements.
quests.textToSpeak: Many companies now offer ___ working options to attract and retain good staff.
quests.correctAnswer: Many companies now offer remote working options to attract and retain good staff.

quests.hint: This noun refers to the period each morning and evening when roads are most congested.
quests.explanation: 'Rush hour traffic,' 'during rush hour,' and 'avoid rush hour' are the key phrases. In the UK, rush hour is typically 7–9am and 5–7pm on weekdays.
quests.textToSpeak: Try to avoid driving during ___ - the traffic is absolutely gridlocked both ways.
quests.correctAnswer: Try to avoid driving during rush hour - the traffic is absolutely gridlocked both ways.

quests.hint: This noun describes the general feeling or mood in a particular place or situation.
quests.explanation: 'Great atmosphere,' 'tense atmosphere,' 'relaxed atmosphere,' and 'create an atmosphere' are key. 'Atmosphere' in a social context means the mood or vibe of a place.
quests.textToSpeak: The restaurant had a wonderful ___ - intimate lighting and very friendly service.
quests.correctAnswer: The restaurant had a wonderful atmosphere - intimate lighting and very friendly service.

quests.hint: This is the type of cooking and food associated with a particular culture or region.
quests.explanation: 'Italian cuisine,' 'French cuisine,' 'local cuisine,' and 'traditional cuisine' are key. 'Cuisine' is more formal than 'food' and used in contexts of culinary culture.
quests.textToSpeak: She loves exploring new places and always enjoys trying the local ___.
quests.correctAnswer: She loves exploring new places and always enjoys trying the local cuisine.

quests.hint: This is critical or constructive information given about someone's work or behaviour.
quests.explanation: 'Give feedback,' 'receive feedback,' 'constructive feedback,' and 'act on feedback' are key. 'Feedback' is uncountable in this professional sense - never 'a feedback.'
quests.textToSpeak: She asked her manager for constructive ___ on how to improve her presentation skills.
quests.correctAnswer: She asked her manager for constructive feedback on how to improve her presentation skills.

quests.hint: This is a formal talk or display prepared to inform or persuade an audience.
quests.explanation: 'Give a presentation,' 'deliver a presentation,' and 'prepare a presentation' are key. 'Presentation skills' are highly valued in professional settings. PowerPoint is a common tool.
quests.textToSpeak: He practised his ___ more than twenty times before delivering it to the board.
quests.correctAnswer: He practised his presentation more than twenty times before delivering it to the board.

quests.hint: This refers to food options that do not contain meat or fish.
quests.explanation: 'Vegetarian option,' 'vegetarian menu,' and 'go vegetarian' are natural. 'Vegan' is stricter - no animal products at all. 'Vegetarianism' is the lifestyle choice.
quests.textToSpeak: She asked the waiter whether there were ___ options available on the menu.
quests.correctAnswer: She asked the waiter whether there were vegetarian options available on the menu.

quests.hint: This is the formal fee charged by a university for studying a particular course.
quests.explanation: 'Tuition fees,' 'pay tuition,' and 'university tuition' are key. 'Tuition' can also refer to private teaching: 'private tuition' or 'one-to-one tuition.'
quests.textToSpeak: The university offers reduced ___ fees for students from lower-income backgrounds.
quests.correctAnswer: The university offers reduced tuition fees for students from lower-income backgrounds.

quests.hint: This is a financial award given to students to help pay for their studies.
quests.explanation: 'Win a scholarship,' 'receive a scholarship,' and 'scholarship programme' are key. 'Academic scholarship' is based on grades; 'sports scholarship' is based on athletic ability.
quests.textToSpeak: She won a full ___ to study at a prestigious university in the United States.
quests.correctAnswer: She won a full scholarship to study at a prestigious university in the United States.

quests.hint: This verb means to successfully complete a university degree or formal programme.
quests.explanation: 'Graduate from,' 'recent graduate,' and 'graduation ceremony' are key. 'Graduate' is both a verb and a noun: 'She is a graduate' (noun). 'Postgraduate' means after the first degree.
quests.textToSpeak: He plans to ___ from university next summer and then travel for a year.
quests.correctAnswer: He plans to graduate from university next summer and then travel for a year.

quests.hint: This adjective describes a person who feels unsure, worried, or on edge about something.
quests.explanation: 'Feel nervous,' 'get nervous,' 'nervous about,' and 'nervous wreck' (very anxious) are key. 'Nervous energy' means anxious excitement. 'Stage fright' is nervousness before performing.
quests.textToSpeak: She felt incredibly ___ before stepping onto the stage for the very first time.
quests.correctAnswer: She felt incredibly nervous before stepping onto the stage for the very first time.

quests.hint: This adjective describes a person who is sure of their abilities and not shy.
quests.explanation: 'Feel confident,' 'self-confident,' 'grow in confidence,' and 'exude confidence' are key. 'Confident that' means certain about a fact. 'Overconfident' means too sure of yourself.
quests.textToSpeak: After months of practice, he felt much more ___ about speaking in public.
quests.correctAnswer: After months of practice, he felt much more confident about speaking in public.

quests.hint: This adjective describes feeling very happy and relieved when a worry is resolved.
quests.explanation: 'Feel relieved,' 'greatly relieved,' and 'a sense of relief' are key. 'Relief' is the noun. 'To my great relief' and 'what a relief!' are natural expressions of the feeling.
quests.textToSpeak: She was absolutely ___ when the doctor told her the test results were normal.
quests.correctAnswer: She was absolutely relieved when the doctor told her the test results were normal.

quests.hint: This is the main story or sequence of events in a novel, film, or series.
quests.explanation: 'The plot thickens' (idiom: becomes more complex). 'Follow the plot,' 'complex plot,' and 'plot twist' are key. 'Spoiler' is when someone reveals the plot before you see it.
quests.textToSpeak: The ___ of the thriller was so complex that she had to watch it twice.
quests.correctAnswer: The plot of the thriller was so complex that she had to watch it twice.

quests.hint: This is a critical evaluation of a film, book, restaurant, or product.
quests.explanation: 'Write a review,' 'read a review,' 'five-star review,' and 'positive review' are key. 'Review' (noun) and 'review' (verb: 'let me review this') are both common.
quests.textToSpeak: The film received glowing ___ from critics who praised its originality.
quests.correctAnswer: The film received glowing reviews from critics who praised its originality.

quests.hint: This is a long-term loan used to buy property, repaid over many years.
quests.explanation: 'Take out a mortgage,' 'repay a mortgage,' and 'fixed-rate mortgage' are key. 'Mortgage lender' gives the money. 'Mortgage repayments' are the regular payments made monthly.
quests.textToSpeak: They took out a twenty-five-year ___ to buy their first family home.
quests.correctAnswer: They took out a twenty-five-year mortgage to buy their first family home.

quests.hint: This is money borrowed from a bank or person that must be repaid with interest.
quests.explanation: 'Take out a loan,' 'repay a loan,' 'personal loan,' and 'student loan' are key. 'Loan agreement' is the formal document. 'Defaulting' on a loan means failing to repay.
quests.textToSpeak: She applied for a student ___ to cover the cost of her university tuition fees.
quests.correctAnswer: She applied for a student loan to cover the cost of her university tuition fees.

quests.hint: This noun refers to putting money into something with the hope it grows in value.
quests.explanation: 'Make an investment,' 'return on investment,' and 'long-term investment' are key. 'Invest' is the verb. 'Investment portfolio' is a collection of financial investments.
quests.textToSpeak: He made a wise ___ in company shares that paid off significantly over five years.
quests.correctAnswer: He made a wise investment in company shares that paid off significantly over five years.

quests.hint: This is the identification and explanation of an illness by a medical professional.
quests.explanation: 'Medical diagnosis,' 'receive a diagnosis,' and 'differential diagnosis' are key. 'Diagnose' is the verb: 'She was diagnosed with...' 'Misdiagnosis' means an incorrect diagnosis.
quests.textToSpeak: The doctor explained the ___ carefully and outlined the available treatment options.
quests.correctAnswer: The doctor explained the diagnosis carefully and outlined the available treatment options.

quests.hint: This refers to the medical care given to a patient with a particular illness.
quests.explanation: 'Receive treatment,' 'course of treatment,' and 'start treatment' are key. 'Treatment plan' is the medical strategy. 'Undergo treatment' means to be receiving it.
quests.textToSpeak: She began a six-month course of ___ that the specialist said was very effective.
quests.correctAnswer: She began a six-month course of treatment that the specialist said was very effective.

quests.hint: This is a doctor with advanced expertise in a particular area of medicine.
quests.explanation: 'See a specialist,' 'refer to a specialist,' and 'specialist appointment' are key. 'Specialist' can refer to any field - not just medicine. 'Speciality' is their specific area.
quests.textToSpeak: Her GP referred her to a ___ for a more detailed and thorough examination.
quests.correctAnswer: Her GP referred her to a specialist for a more detailed and thorough examination.

quests.hint: This is the annual commemoration of an important event such as a wedding or founding.
quests.explanation: 'Wedding anniversary,' 'celebrate an anniversary,' and 'silver anniversary' (25 years) are key. 'Golden anniversary' is 50 years. 'The anniversary of' is the natural structure.
quests.textToSpeak: They celebrated their twentieth wedding ___ with a wonderful trip to Rome.
quests.correctAnswer: They celebrated their twentieth wedding anniversary with a wonderful trip to Rome.

quests.hint: This is the formal agreement to get married - the period before the wedding.
quests.explanation: 'Announce your engagement,' 'engagement ring,' and 'during their engagement' are key. 'Get engaged' is the verb phrase. 'Engage' in this sense means to promise to marry.
quests.textToSpeak: She announced her ___ to her family over a special celebratory dinner.
quests.correctAnswer: She announced her engagement to her family over a special celebratory dinner.

quests.hint: This noun refers to a special event or important moment in someone's life.
quests.explanation: 'Special occasion,' 'on the occasion of,' and 'dress for the occasion' are key. 'Formal occasion' requires smart dress. 'Rise to the occasion' means to perform well when it matters.
quests.textToSpeak: It was a truly special ___ that everyone present would long remember.
quests.correctAnswer: It was a truly special occasion that everyone present would long remember.

quests.hint: This verb means to give money or goods to help a cause or organisation.
quests.explanation: 'Donate to charity,' 'donate blood,' and 'donate your time' are key. 'Donation' is the noun. 'Generous donation' and 'anonymous donation' are common collocations.
quests.textToSpeak: She decided to ___ a portion of her bonus to a local children's charity.
quests.correctAnswer: She decided to donate a portion of her bonus to a local children's charity.

quests.hint: This is an event organised to collect money for a particular cause or charity.
quests.explanation: 'Hold a fundraiser,' 'attend a fundraiser,' and 'charity fundraiser' are key. 'Fundraising' is the activity. 'Fundraiser event' can be anything from a bake sale to a gala.
quests.textToSpeak: The school held a ___ to raise money for the new sports and arts facility.
quests.correctAnswer: The school held a fundraiser to raise money for the new sports and arts facility.

quests.hint: This is an organisation that provides help to those in need without profit motivation.
quests.explanation: 'Give to charity,' 'work for a charity,' and 'charitable organisation' are key. 'Charitable' is the adjective. 'Charity shop' sells donated goods to raise money for good causes.
quests.textToSpeak: He volunteers for a ___ that provides hot meals for homeless people in winter.
quests.correctAnswer: He volunteers for a charity that provides hot meals for homeless people in winter.
